metaTitle: Custom Direct to Film Workwear | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom direct to film workwear for your team. Vibrant, durable prints on jackets, vests, and more at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Direct to film printing allows for high-detail, full-color designs on a variety of workwear fabrics, from cotton duck jackets to polyester vests. Unlike traditional screen printing, DTF transfers create a soft hand feel and excellent wash durability, making it ideal for safety vests, shop coats, and uniform shirts that see daily use. This method also works well on zippered or pocketed garments where screen printing can be tricky.
heroAltText: Custom direct to film workwear featuring a high-visibility vest with a full-color logo print
